country.evidence_quote: YouthLine is a peer-to-peer help, support, and crisis line serving youth ages 10-24 across the United States since 2000. YouthLine is staffed by youth volunteers and young adult interns who undergo extensive training and are supervised by highly skilled clinicians.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: YouthLine strives to give specific attention to communities historically forgotten in conversations about mental health. This led to the creation and launch of YouthLine Native – taking the already strong foundations of YouthLine, collaborating with the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs, Nine Tribes of Oregon, and tribal communities across the nation to create culturally-responsive training on mental health for native youth, promoting help-seeking behaviors by normalizing reaching out for help

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: We currently have two call centers in Portland and Bend, Oregon, and satellite locations in Portland and Warm Springs, Oregon. We are opening a call center in Hawai’i on the island of Maui this Fall. We are headquartered in Oregon but serve youth across the country, and even around the world, through our help, support, and crisis line.
